blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The value of memory lies not only in recall but in using it to provide appropriate assistance. Recent benchmarks test memory use in personalisation and agentic tasks, but seldom evaluate assistance without fixed answers or integration across multiple participants. Group chats make both challenges more acute: an assistant must integrate information from multiple members, track revisions and conflicts over time, and produce one response for the group. Yet existing group memory benchmarks rely on synthetic conversations and inherit constrained evaluation from general memory benchmarks, focusing on recall against fixed answers or decisions over a closed set. We introduce GroupAssistBench, the first memory benchmark from real-world group conversations with a deployed group assistant, covering 80,299 messages in 50 groups and costing over $53K. Over the same histories, GroupAssistBench evaluates memory recall (L1) with reference answers and memory use (L2) with service requests without fixed answers across single, distributed, and conflicting memories (M1--M3). Requests are verified to require group history, memories are anchored to their sources, and L2 uses tailored rubrics with penalties derived from real user feedback. Across evaluations of frontier models with full context, retrieval methods, and memory systems, the strongest memory system rivals full context on recall but falls far behind on use, especially for distributed and conflicting memories. Together, two additions that relate retrieved memories and bind remembered facts as response constraints bring consistent gains, showing that group memory systems must improve use, not recall alone.
blocks.zh: 记忆的价值不仅在于记忆,还在于利用记忆提供适当援助。 最近的基准测试了个人化和代理任务中的内存使用,但很少在没有固定答案或多个参与者的整合的情况下评价援助. 分组聊天使得这两个挑战更加尖锐:一个助手必须整合来自多个成员的信息,跟踪一段时间内的修订和冲突,并为小组生成一个响应. 然而,现有的群体内存基准依赖于合成对话,并继承了一般内存基准中受限制的评价,侧重于对照固定答案或对一个封闭的一组决定进行召回. 我们介绍GroupAssist Bench,这是现实世界小组与部署的小组助理对话的第一个内存基准,涵盖50个小组的80 299条信息,费用超过53K美元。 在同一段历史中,GroupAsist Bench用参考答案和内存使用(L2)来评价内存召回(L1),服务请求没有固定答案,跨越单个,分布,相互冲突的记忆(M1-M3). 请求被核实为需要群体历史,记忆被固定在源头上,L2使用特制标题,从真实的用户反馈中得出处罚. 在对具有完整背景的前沿模型、检索方法和记忆系统的评价中,最强的记忆系统在召回方面与完整背景相对应,但远远落后于使用,特别是在分布式记忆和相互冲突的记忆方面。 由于反应限制,两个与被检索的记忆相关联的添加和将记忆中的事实捆绑在一起,共同带来持续收益,表明群体记忆系统必须改进使用,而不只是召回.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Memory is a core component of agents built on LLMs and has been widely studied in recent years ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) .
Recent benchmarks have moved beyond factual recall to evaluate whether remembered information supports personalization ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) and agentic task completion ( He et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
This shift from remembering information to using it effectively becomes especially challenging in multi-user settings. Group chats provide a particularly demanding setting for this shift from recall to use: unlike a personal assistant serving one user, an assistant in a group chat serves the group as a whole and must produce a single response that reconciles information distributed across members, revised over time, or contested within the group ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ; Owolabi, 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
记忆是LLMS上所建的剂的核心成分,近年来被广泛研究(Maharana等,2024;Wu等,2025;Hu等,2025.).
最近的基准已经超越了对事实的回顾,以评估记忆中的信息是否支持个性化(Jiang等,2025;Shao等,2026;Xie等,2026)和代理任务完成(He等,2026;Zhao等,2026).
这种从记忆信息到有效利用信息的转变在多用户环境中尤其具有挑战性。 分组聊天为从召回到使用这一转变提供了特别苛刻的设置:与服务于一个用户的私人助理不同,分组聊天中的助理服务于整个小组,必须产生一个单一的响应来调和在成员间分发,随时间推移而修改,或在小组内有争议的信息(Yang等,2026;Hu等,2026b;Owolabi,2026;Ren等,2026).

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks for group memory already examine how information is attributed, integrated, and updated, and show that systems designed for one user exhibit distinct failures in group settings ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Owolabi, 2026 ) .
Yet their evaluation inherits a broader limitation of current memory benchmarks: success is measured primarily through recall. Questions ask who said what or which value is current and are scored against fixed reference answers, while tasks closer to assistance use multiple choice ( Hu et al., 2026b ) or selection from a closed set of actions ( Ren et al., 2026 ) .
This leaves unanswered whether a system that retrieves the right memory can use it to respond appropriately to a service request without a fixed answer. Evidence from settings with one user shows why this distinction matters: on AlpsBench, memory raises persona awareness from 0.41 to 0.72 while reducing emotional appropriateness below the backbone without memory ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) .
A separate limitation is that current benchmarks for group memory use synthetic conversations, leaving it unclear whether their tasks capture how agreements, corrections, and assistance failures arise in deployed groups ( Owolabi, 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
团体内存的现有基准已经研究了信息如何归属、整合和更新,并表明为一个用户设计的系统在团体设置中显示出明显的故障(Yang等,2026;Owolabi,2026)。
然而,他们的评价继承了目前记忆基准的更广泛限制:成功主要通过召回来衡量。 问题问谁说什么或哪些价值是当前值,并且根据固定的参考答案得到分数,而更接近援助的任务则使用多种选择(Hu等,2026b)或从封闭的一组行动中选择(Ren等,2026).
这使得一个检索出正确内存的系统能否在没有固定答案的情况下使用它来对服务请求作出适当回应而得不到答案. 来自一个用户的设置的证据表明,这种区别为何重要:在阿尔卑斯-本奇,记忆将人的认识从0.41提高到了0.72,同时将情感的适宜性降低到没有记忆的骨干下(Xiao等,2026年).
另外一个限制是,目前团体内存的基准使用合成对话,因此不清楚他们的任务是否掌握了部署的团体如何产生协议、纠正和援助失败(Owolabi,2026;Hu等,2026b)。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce GroupAssistBench , a benchmark built on 50 group conversations involving a deployed assistant, containing 80K messages and 2,395 questions. GroupAssistBench organises evaluation along two orthogonal axes, include: 1) The task axis, aims to distinguish memory recall (L1), which asks a question about the history and has a reference answer, from memory use (L2), which poses a service request without a fixed answer and requires a reply that respects the memories it depends on. This axis measures whether a model can move from retrieving remembered information to using it appropriately in an open-ended response, and 2) The dependency axis, aims to distinguish whether the required memories are single (M1), distributed across members (M2), or conflicting (M3). This axis measures how well a model can integrate and reconcile memory evidence as its dependency structure becomes more complex. Figure 1 gives an overview of GroupAssistBench .
Each request is verified to require the group history, and each required memory is anchored to a verbatim span in the original conversation.
L1 answers are scored on atomic facts, while L2 replies are scored with rubrics tailored to each instance, whose penalty criteria are derived from real user feedback on the assistant.
As shown in Table 1 , GroupAssistBench is the first benchmark that combines conversations among multiple participants with a deployed assistant, memory use through requests without fixed answers, and criteria derived from feedback.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了GroupAssist Bench,这是基于50个小组对话的基准,其中涉及一名已部署的助理,包含80K讯息和2 395个问题。 GroupAssist Bench沿着两个正交轴组织评价,包括: 1)任务轴,旨在区分内存回想(L1),它从内存使用(L2)中询问历史问题并有参考答案,它提出没有固定答案的服务请求,需要尊重所依赖的记忆的回想. 这一轴线衡量一个模型是否能够从检索记忆中的信息转向在无限制反应中适当使用,以及2) 依赖轴旨在区分所需记忆是单(M1),在成员之间分布(M2)还是相冲突(M3). 这一轴线衡量一个模型在依赖性结构变得更加复杂时,能够如何整合和调和内存证据。 图1概括了GroupAsist Bench的情况。
每个请求都被核实为需要组史,每个需要的内存被固定在原对话的逐字记录中.
L1的答案是在原子事实上得到的分数,而L2的回答则是以每个实例所定制的分数来得到的分数,其罚分标准来自用户对助手的真实反馈.
如表1所显示,GroupAssist Bench是第一个将多个参与者与部署的助手的对话,内存通过没有固定答案的请求使用,以及反馈衍生出的标准相结合的基准.

blocks.en:
We evaluate 14 configurations on GroupAssistBench , covering frontier LLMs with full context (e.g., Claude-sonnet-5 and GPT-5.6-terra), retrieval-augmented systems, and external memory systems.
The results reveal a gap along each axis. Along the task axis, the strongest memory system surpasses Full Context with the same backbone on memory recall (0.621 vs. 0.570) but falls far behind on memory use (0.247 vs. 0.431). Along the dependency axis, the Full Context score for memory use drops from 0.505 on M1 to 0.303 on M3.
Further analysis highlights two promising directions for group memory assistants: relational evidence organisation and assistance constraint binding (§ 5 ). Together, these results show that evaluating recall alone overstates the value of memory to a group.
Our contributions are threefold: 1. We introduce GroupAssistBench , the first benchmark built on real group conversations to evaluate memory along two axes: recall versus use, and single versus multiple or conflicting memories. 2. We develop a traceable framework that verifies history dependence, grounds memories in source messages, and evaluates responses using criteria specific to each request and based on real user feedback. 3. Experiments across full context, retrieval methods, and memory systems reveal complementary retrieval and application bottlenecks that relational evidence organisation and assistance constraint binding mitigate.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了GroupAssist Bench上的14个配置,涵盖具有全面背景的前沿LLMs(如克洛德-森特-5和GPT-5.6-terra),检索增强系统以及外部内存系统.
结果显示,每个轴线都存在差距。 在任务轴上,最强的内存系统在记忆召回(0.621 vs. 0.570)上与同为主干线的"Full Content"超越了"记忆召回"(0.247 vs. 0.431)。 在依赖轴上,内存使用的全上下文分数从M1上的0.505降至M3上的0.303.
进一步的分析突出了团体记忆助理有希望的两个方向:关系证据组织和约束援助(第5节)。 这些结果表明,仅仅评价召回就过分夸大了记忆对一个群体的价值。
我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 我们介绍GroupAssist Bench,这是在真实的小组对话基础上建立的第一个基准,目的是按照两个轴线评估记忆:召回与使用,以及单一的与多或相冲突的记忆。 2. 我们制定可追踪的框架,以核实历史的依赖性,将记忆作为源信息的依据,并使用针对每项请求的具体标准,根据真正的用户反馈,评估答复。 3. 整个背景的实验、检索方法和内存系统揭示了互补的检索和应用瓶颈,这些瓶颈关系上的证据组织和约束援助的制约减轻了这些瓶颈。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Long-term memory benchmarks began with factual recall over extended conversation histories ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026c ) and have since turned to how memory supports downstream behavior, such as personalized responses ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , implicit constraints on later replies ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and multi-session agentic tasks ( He et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . All of them target a single user and score memory use in a closed form, or judge free-form answers holistically ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , which does not tell which memory was used or misused. Rubric-based evaluation is finer grained ( Arora et al., 2025 ; Ding, 2026 ) , but its criteria are written by benchmark designers, and real user feedback has served only as a satisfaction label on the whole response ( Hong et al., 2026 ) . GroupAssistBench scores open-ended memory use whose required memories come from multiple users, with grounding criteria instantiated from the verified memories of each request and penalty criteria derived from real user feedback on the assistant’s failures, so that the criteria name which memory was misused.
blocks.zh: 长期记忆基准始于对长篇谈话历史的事实回顾(Maharana等,2024;Wu等,2025;Hu等,2026c),并自此转向记忆如何支持下游行为,如个性化反应(Jiang等,2025;Xiao等,2026;Xie等,2026),对后期答复的隐含限制(Li等,2026),多会代理任务(He等,2026;赵等,2026). 他们都以一个单一用户为目标,并以封闭的形式给内存使用打分,或者整体判断自由格式的答案(Wu等,2025;Li等,2026),没有说明使用或滥用了哪个内存. 以Rubric为基础的评价是更精细的(Arora等,2025;Ding,2026),但其标准由基准设计者来写出,真实的用户反馈仅作为整个响应(Hong等,2026)的满意标签. GroupAsist Bench对来自多个用户所需记忆的开放式内存使用进行评分,对每项请求的已核实记忆进行即时定位标准,对助手失败的真实用户反馈产生的罚则标准进行分数,从而误用内存的标准名.

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks extend memory evaluation to groups, covering speaker-grounded belief tracking and group dynamics ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , temporally evolving decisions across interleaved groups ( Hu et al., 2026b ) , group norms versus individual exceptions ( Owolabi, 2026 ) , and memory governance among multiple principals ( Ren et al., 2026 ) . They show that memory systems designed for a single user fail characteristically in groups, for example by conflating speakers or overwriting earlier statements. As Table 1 summarizes, their conversations are LLM-synthesized and their tasks are scored against fixed answers, with assistance-like tasks cast as multiple-choice questions ( Hu et al., 2026b ) or a closed set of actions ( Ren et al., 2026 ) ; where per-instance criteria exist, they specify required content ( Ren et al., 2026 ) or penalize misattribution ( Owolabi, 2026 ) by design rather than from observed user reactions. GroupAssistBench instead builds on conversations with a deployed assistant and evaluates recall and use over the same histories.
blocks.zh: 近期基准将记忆评价扩展到各群体,涵盖基于发言者的信仰跟踪和群体动态(Yang等,2026年),跨不同群体时间变化的决定(Hu等,2026年b),群体规范与个别例外(Owolabi,2026年),以及多个主体的记忆治理(Ren等,2026年). 它们表明,为单一用户设计的内存系统在组别上具有典型的失败性,例如,通过将发言者合在一起或覆盖先前的发言. 如表1所总结,他们的对话是LLM合成的,他们的任务是按固定的答案来打分的,援助类的任务被设定为多选择问题(Hu等,2026b)或一组封闭的行动(Ren等,2026;如果存在深入调查标准,他们会通过设计而不是从观察到的用户反应中指定所需内容(Ren等,2026)或惩罚误配(Owolabi,2026). GroupAssist Bench转而利用与一名已部署的助理的对话,评价同一历史的召回和使用。

blocks.en: 3 GroupAssistBench
blocks.zh: 3 个小组

blocks.en: GroupAssistBench evaluates whether a system can recall a group’s history and, more importantly, whether it can use that history to assist the group. This section formulates the tasks (Section 3.1 ), presents the construction pipeline that turns group conversations into instances (Section 3.2 ), and defines the scoring of responses (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: GroupAsist Bench 评估一个系统是否能够回忆一个集团的历史,更重要的是,它是否能够利用这个历史来帮助这个集团. 本节阐述各项任务(第3.1节),介绍将集体对话变成实例的施工管道(第3.2节)并界定答复的分数(第3.3节)。

A = { a 1 , … , a n } ⊂ H < c A=\{a_{1},\dots,a_{n}\}\subset H_{<c} is the set of required memories , the facts established in the history that a good response to q q depends on, each anchored to a message in H < c H_{<c} . blocks.en:
In memory recall (L1), q q is a question about the history itself, such as which restaurant the group has settled on, and K K is a set of reference facts, one for each memory in A A .
In memory use (L2), q q is an open-ended request for assistance, such as drafting a plan, making a recommendation, or writing a summary for the group, and K K is a rubric specific to the instance, since the memories in A A constrain an appropriate response without determining a single output.
For the reminder request in Figure 1 , for example, the rubric checks that the reply uses the revised departure date and counts all nine travellers, and penalizes reverting to the original date.
Both levels are built over the same group histories, which allows us to compare how well a system recalls the memories with how well it uses them.

Conflicting memories (M3) instances have the structure of M2 and additionally contain a conflict pair ( a old , a new ) ⊂ A (a^{\mathrm{old}},a^{\mathrm{new}})\subset A : two values of the same matter, stated at different times or by different members, of which the conversation has made a new a^{\mathrm{new}} the current one.
The query gives no cue that anything has changed, so a system must notice the revision on its own; the departure date of Figure 1 , moved from May 1 to April 30, is such a pair.

blocks.en:
The construction pipeline of GroupAssistBench is shown in Figure 2 .
We locate the requests whose answer depends on the group history, anchor the memories each request requires to the messages that establish them, assign the dependency type from the structure of the anchors, build the instance with its answer key, and apply quality control .
Throughout, every field produced by a language model is checked programmatically before it enters the benchmark, and instances that fail are excluded rather than repaired.

在整个过程中,语言模型产生的每一个字段在进入基准之前都要按程序加以检查,而失败的事例则排除在外而不是修复。

blocks.en: GroupAssistBench is built from Chinese group conversations in a deployed application, and the assistant replies are its original outputs. Messages are pseudonymized and rewritten to remove residual personal information, with English translations provided. The groups span everyday settings such as trip planning, classes, hobby communities, and project coordination. The evaluation set contains 2,395 instances sampled from 9.5K validated candidates across 50 groups and 80K messages. Although M2 is defined by the number of required memories, 56% of M2 and 93% of M3 instances draw anchors from at least two members. Table 2 reports the full statistics. Appendix A.1 details source selection, and Appendix G provides more examples.

Every instance passes deterministic gates: each anchor and cited premise must precede the cutoff, each span must be found verbatim in its message, and the query must neither reveal a required memory nor, for M3, hint that a value has changed. To assess the resulting quality, three annotators independently examined 120 instances stratified by level, dependency, and source: 95.8% are valid by majority vote and 84.2% unanimously, with pairwise agreement of 93–98% per question. On the 60 L2 instances, the annotators further rated each rubric for the soundness of its service criteria, the relevance of its penalty criteria, and its overall completeness; 90.0% of the rubrics pass all three checks by majority and 86.7% unanimously (Appendix C ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: Following prior work Zhao et al. (2026) ; He et al. (2026) , we compare three memory-access paradigms: Full Context , Retrieval-Augmented Systems , and External Memory Systems . We characterise their memory organisation using the topology taxonomy of Hu et al. (2025) : 1D flat memory has no explicit inter-unit relations, 2D planar memory organises units within a single structural layer, and 3D hierarchical memory connects representations across multiple abstraction levels. Full Context is a 1D reference that directly provides all prior messages and assistant trajectories, and we evaluate four backbones: Claude-sonnet-5, GPT-5.6-terra, Deepseek-v4-flash and Qwen-3.5-9b. Retrieval-Augmented Systems index the same history and include two 1D methods, BM25 and dense embedding retrieval, one 2D method, GraphRAG Edge et al. (2024) , and one 3D method, RAPTOR Sarthi et al. (2024) . External Memory Systems abstract, organise, or update the interaction history before retrieval. They include two representatives at each level: Mem0 Chhikara et al. (2025) and LightMem Fang et al. (2026) for 1D, A-MEM Xu et al. (2025) and MemoryOS Kang et al. (2025) for 2D, and xMemory Hu et al. (2026d) and EverMemOS Hu et al. (2026a) for 3D. This design covers both retrieval and external memory across the three topology levels without treating structural complexity as an ordering of capability.

Full Control是一个1D的参考文献,直接提供所有之前的信息和助手轨迹,我们评价了四个主干: Claude-sonnet-5, GPT-5.6-terra, Deepseek-v4-flash and Quen-3.5-9b. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-20. 检索-增强系统指数相同,包括两个一维方法,BM25和密集嵌入检索,一个二维方法,GraphRAG Edge等 (2024),和一个三维方法,RAPTOR Sarthi等 (2024). 外部内存系统抽象,组织,或者在检索前更新交互历史. 每一级有两名代表: Mem0 Chhikara等 (2025)和LightMem Fang等 (2026)为1D,A-MEM Xu等 (2025)和MumyOS Kang等 (2025)为2D,xMemory Hu等 (2026d)和EverMemOS Hu等 (2026a)为3D. 这一设计涵盖三个地貌层面的检索和外部内存,而没有将结构复杂性视为能力的顺序。

blocks.en: We use GPT-5.6-terra as the task agent for retrieval and external memory systems and GPT-5.6-sol as the evaluator. BM25 and dense retrieval return the top 20 units. All embedding matching uses text-embedding-3-small . Because the source conversations are in Chinese, we execute and score tasks in Chinese to preserve their meaning and context and avoid translation artefacts. We provide a complete English translation for reference and future research. Each question has a cutoff that limits context and memory construction to earlier turns, preventing answer leakage. Appendices E and H detail the setup and prompts.

blocks.en: Using GPT-5.6-sol as the judge, we report mean Atom Recall and factual F1 for L1, mean rubric score S ¯ \bar{S} for L2, and mean context tokens. We break results down by M1–M3 and rank methods by overall Atom Recall and S ¯ \bar{S} , following Section 3.3 . To validate the judge, three annotators independently marked every rubric criterion for 180 real responses to 60 sampled L2 instances. The judge agrees with the human majority on 89.3% of the 1,152 criterion judgments, the same level as the annotators agree with one another (89.8%). When errors occur, the judge tends to give too little credit to grounding and service criteria and apply penalties too often, making scores conservative. The judge also ranks the three systems identically to every annotator. Appendix C.3 provides details.

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that Full Context methods remain competitive on both L1 and L2 tasks. DeepSeek-v4-flash obtains L1 met of 0.669 and L2 rubric score S ¯ \bar{S} of 0.469, while GPT-5.6-terra reaches 0.570 and 0.431, respectively. Within RAG systems, BM25 and dense retrieval obtain higher overall scores than GraphRAG and RAPTOR on both tasks, indicating that additional structural complexity does not consistently improve performance in this setting. Among external memory systems, hierarchical methods show promising L1 recall: EverMemOS and xMemory attain the met of 0.621 and 0.546, placing third and fifth among all evaluated baselines. Flat retrieval is more effective within RAG, whereas hierarchical systems show stronger L1 recall within external memory. This pattern is consistent with concerns that summary hierarchies can obscure factual distinctions Hu et al. (2026d) and highlights hierarchical memory organisation as an emerging direction for supporting reasoning across abstraction levels Hu et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 表3显示,在L1和L2任务上, " 全面背景 " 方法仍然具有竞争力。 DeepSeek-v4-flash获得L1相遇0.669分和L2卢布得分S'\bar{S}0.469分,而GPT-5.6-terra则分别达到0.570分和0.431分. 在RAG系统内,BM25和密集取回在这两个任务上的总分都高于GraphRAG和RAPTOR,这表明额外的结构复杂性无法持续地改善这种环境下的性能. 在外部内存系统中,分级方法显示,L1记忆很有希望:EverMemOS和xMemory达到0.621和0.546,在所有评估的基线中排名第三和第五。 平面回取在RAG内部更有效,而分级系统则显示外部内存中较强的L1回取. 这种模式与下述关切是一致的,即简要的分级可能模糊了Hu et al. (2026d)的事实区别,并强调分级记忆组织是支持跨越抽象层次的推理的新方向(2025).

blocks.en: Performance generally degrades as queries move beyond dependence on a single memory. L1 met decreases from M1 to both M2 and M3 for all 14 evaluated baselines, and L2 shows a similar pattern except for xMemory and EverMemOS. For example, with GPT-5.6-terra under Full Context, L1 met drops from 0.685 on M1 to 0.436 and 0.377 on M2 and M3, while the L2 score decreases from 0.505 to 0.435 and 0.303. These drops highlight the difficulty of integrating complementary memories across speakers or turns in M2 and selecting the current or applicable memories amid updates, conflicts, or contextual constraints in M3. The two 3D external memory systems, EverMemOS and xMemory, show the strongest L1 robustness under this shift, with smaller M1 to M3 declines than every Full Context and RAG configuration. EverMemOS declines from 0.679 to 0.561, while Full Context with GPT-5.6-terra declines from 0.685 to 0.377. xMemory declines from 0.620 to 0.435. EverMemOS also improves on L2 from 0.137 on M1 to 0.284 on M2 and 0.253 on M3. Together, these results highlight the potential of hierarchical external memory organisation to preserve and aggregate evidence across multiple memory anchors.
blocks.zh: 性能一般会随着查询超越对单个内存的依赖而退化. 在所有14个评估基线中,L1从M1降至M2和M3,除了xMemory和EverMemOS外,L2显示出类似的模式。 例如由GPT-5.6-terra在"全面背景"下,L1遭遇了由M1的0.685降至0.436和M2和M3的0.377,而L2的得分则由0.505降至0.435和0.303. 这些下降凸显出在M2中将发言者之间或转接者之间的互补记忆整合起来,以及在M3中更新、冲突或背景限制中选择当前或适用的记忆的困难。 两个3D外部内存系统EverMemOS和xMemory在这一转变下表现出最强的L1稳健性,比起每个全上下文和RAG配置,M1到M3的下降. EverMemOS从0.679降至0.561,而GPT-5.6-terra的"全环境"从0.685降至0.377. x 记忆从0.620降至0.435. EverMemOS还改进了L2从M1上的0.137到M2上的0.284和M3上的0.253. 这些成果共同凸显了分级的外部记忆组织在保存和汇总多个记忆锚的证据方面的潜力。

blocks.en: The relative strengths of retrieval and external memory systems reverse from L1 to L2. On L1, EverMemOS surpasses Full Context with GPT-5.6-terra in mean met (0.621 vs. 0.570), while EverMemOS (0.621) and xMemory (0.546) outperform all RAG systems (0.504–0.539). On L2, however, every RAG system (0.334–0.370) outperforms every external memory system (0.139–0.269). This advantage is only relative because all RAG systems remain below Full Context with GPT-5.6-terra (0.431), while BM25 and dense retrieval outperform GraphRAG and RAPTOR. Thus, strong recall by external memory systems does not translate into effective assistance, while RAG provides stronger but still limited support.
blocks.zh: 检索和外部内存系统的相对优势从L1反向为L2. 在L1上,EverMemOS超过了GPT-5.6-terra的完全上下文,平均达到(0.621对0.570),而EverMemOS(0.621)和xMemory(0.546)则超过了所有RAG系统(0.504-0.539)。 然而,在L2上,每个RAG系统(0.334–0.370)的性能都超过了每个外部内存系统(0.139–0.269)。 这一优势只是相对的,因为所有RAG系统在GPT-5.6-terra(0.431)的GPT-5.6-terra上仍然低于Full Context,而BM25和密集回取则超过GraphRAG和RAPTOR. 因此,外部记忆系统的强烈回想并不能转化为有效的援助,而RAG则提供更强而有限的支持.

blocks.en: To examine whether reduced context usage during queries offsets memory construction, we compute total deployment cost over the full dataset as construction cost paid once plus retrieval and generation costs across all queries. Figure 3 separates these components. At the observed workload of all queries, BM25, dense retrieval, LightMem, RAPTOR, and Mem0 cost less than Full Context with the same GPT-5.6-terra task agent. For example, dense retrieval costs $55.0 in total, compared with $260.4 for Full Context, while RAPTOR reaches $204.5 after amortising its $127.6 construction cost. Lower cost, however, does not imply stronger performance. LightMem costs only $69.6 but obtains the lowest L1 and L2 averages, whereas EverMemOS achieves the highest L1 average among external memory systems but costs $814.9 and requires 11,138 queries to break even. Overall, an efficient memory system must balance construction overhead and savings with effective memory recall and assistance. Detailed statistics for each stage are reported in Appendix F.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了审查查询期间上下文使用量的减少是否抵消了内存构造,我们将整个数据集的总部署费用计算为一次性支付的施工费用加上所有查询的检索和生成费用。 图3将这些组成部分分开。 在观察到的所有查询工作量中,BM25、密集检索、LightMem、RAPTOR和Mem0的成本低于GPT-5.6-terra任务代理的Full Context。 例如,密集检索费用共计55.0美元,而全面检索费用为260.4美元,而RAPTOR在摊还127.6美元建筑费用后达到204.5美元。 然而,降低成本并不意味着业绩会更好。 光线 Mem成本只有69.6美元,但获得最低的L1和L2平均值,而EverMemOS在外部内存系统中实现最高的L1平均值,但成本为814.9美元,需要11,138个查询来打破均分. 总的来说,一个有效的记忆系统必须平衡建筑间接费用和节余与有效的记忆召回和援助。 附录F.1报告了每个阶段的详细统计数据。

blocks.zh: 5 分析

The other segments show whether recalled memories were used, retrieved but unused, or not retrieved at L2. blocks.en: The gap between L1 and L2 does not show whether systems use memories they can recall, since the two levels contain different instances. We therefore identify 497 memories queried directly in L1 and required by an L2 request in the same group, and test whether each system uses in L2 what it recalls in L1 (Figure 4 ). Across all six memory systems, recalled but unused memories account for 21–27% of all pairs, versus 11–16% for models given full context. Even EverMemOS matches their recall (66% vs. 47–70%) but uses fewer recalled memories (65% vs. 73–85%). This fraction correlates more strongly with the L2 ranking in Table 3 ( ρ = 0.89 \rho=0.89 ) than recall itself does ( ρ = 0.56 \rho=0.56 ). Why are memories recalled at L1 left unused at L2? We split unused memories into those absent from the model input and those present but unapplied. (i) For memory systems, 36% of unused memories never entered the L2 input. This retrieval failure was cue dependent. L1 questions usually identify the target memory, whereas L2 requests often do not. Four of the six systems retrieved 84–100% of the same memories when L1 named them directly, and input coverage across all pairs rose from 62% to 83% as lexical overlap increased. (ii) The other 64% were in the input and still not used in the reply. This failure depends on the cue as well, with memories already in the input used more often when requests shared their wording or were framed around the same matter. Without such cues, memory systems can thus fail twice, in retrieving the relevant memory and in applying it when present. These failures motivate retrieving evidence independently of request wording and binding available memories to the response. Analyses by generation model and request type appear in Appendix F.2 .
blocks.zh: L1和L2之间的空隙没有显示系统是否使用它们可以回想的记忆,因为这两个关卡包含不同的实例. 因此,我们确定在L1中直接被询问的497个记忆,以及同一组的L2请求所要求的记忆,并测试每个系统是否在L2中使用它在L1中回顾的内容(图4)。 在所有六个记忆系统中,回顾但未使用的记忆占全部对数的21-27%,而模型则占11-16%。 即使EverMemOS也符合他们的召回(66%对47-70%),但使用召回的记忆较少(65%对73-85%)。 这一分数与表3中的L2排名(为0.89\rho=0.89)相比,与召回本身的关系更为密切(为0.56\rho=0.56)。 为什么在L1的记忆在L2没有使用? 我们把未使用的记忆分为模型输入中缺失的记忆和未应用的记忆。 (一)对于内存系统,36%的未用记忆从未输入L2输入. 此检索失败取决于提示 。 L1问题通常能识别出目标内存,而L2请求往往不会. 六个系统中有四个在L1直接命名时检索了84–100%的同一种记忆,随着词汇重叠的增加,所有对子的输入覆盖率从62%上升到83%. (二) 其他64%在输入中,答复中仍未使用。 这种失败也取决于提示,当请求分享其措辞或围绕着同一事项时,在投入中已经使用的记忆更为频繁。 没有这种提示,内存系统就可能因此两次出故障,在检索出相关的内存并在出现时应用. 这些失败促使人们不顾要求的措辞而独立地取回证据,并将现有记忆与答复联系在一起。 按生成模型和请求类型进行的分析载于附录F.2。

blocks.en: Finding 1 Explicit relational evidence organisation recovers memories that the request does not name.
blocks.zh: 调查结果1 明确关系证据组织恢复请求未标明的记忆。

blocks.en: Better generation cannot recover evidence omitted by retrieval. We introduce Relational Evidence Refinement (RER) , which makes relations among retrieved memories explicit and follows them to supplement missing supporting evidence without relying on the wording of the request. We evaluate RER on xMemory and EverMemOS because of their leading L1 performance, and on flat LightMem to test generality. Missing evidence accounts for 74% of unused memories in LightMem, compared with 22% in xMemory and 14% in EverMemOS, as shown by the dark grey segments in Figure 4 . Table 4 confirms this pattern. RER gives flat LightMem the largest average gains (+8.4 L1 met and +6.3 L2 S ¯ \bar{S} ), because it omits most evidence, and smaller gains to hierarchical xMemory and EverMemOS, whose evidence is more complete. On L1 M2/M3, anchor coverage exceeds met for xMemory (0.64–0.68 vs. 0.44–0.46) and EverMemOS (0.80–0.85 vs. 0.54–0.56). RER narrows this gap because integrating evidence across members and turns requires the connecting memories to be present.
blocks.zh: 更好的生成无法取回被取回而省去的证据. 我们引入了关系证据完善(RER),它明确了检索记忆之间的关系,并遵循它们来补充缺失的佐证证据,而不依赖于请求的措辞。 我们评价RER在xMemory和EverMemOS上,因为它们的领先L1性能,在平平的LightMem上测试通俗性. 缺少的证据占了LightMem中未使用的记忆的74%,而XMemory中为22%,EverMemOS中为14%,如图4中暗灰色部分所示. 表4证实了这一模式。 RER给予平坦的LightMem最大的平均收益(已满足的+8.4 L1和+6.3 L2 S'\bar{S}),因为它省略了大多数证据,对分级的xMemory和EverMemOS的增益较小,其证据较为完整. 在L1 M2/M3上,主播覆盖超过所达到的xMemory(0.64–0.68对0.44–0.46)和EverMemOS(0.80–0.85对0.54–0.56). RER缩小了这一差距,因为整合跨成员的证据并转弯需要存在连接记忆.

blocks.en: Finding 2 Effective assistance requires binding memories that are already present to the response.
blocks.zh: 发现2 有效援助需要已存在的具有约束力的记忆。

blocks.en: Table 5: Assistance Constraint Binding on L2 by memory dependency.
blocks.zh: 表5:按内存依赖程度对L2进行约束的援助。

blocks.en: The larger share of the loss comes from memories that reach the L2 input but remain unused. They account for 78% of unused memories for xMemory and 86% for EverMemOS. This application failure helps explain why EverMemOS falls from third on L1 to tenth on L2 and xMemory from fifth to thirteenth. We introduce Assistance Constraint Binding (ACB) , which determines each remembered fact’s subject, scope, status, and applicability, then binds the validated conditions to generation. Table 5 again matches the decomposition: ACB improves xMemory and EverMemOS most on M1 (+6.8 and +6.6 S ¯ \bar{S} ), where the relevant facts are already available and the experiment isolates whether they are interpreted and enforced, while LightMem gains less because its primary bottleneck is missing evidence, which ACB cannot recover. When combined, the two modules perform best for every system on both levels, but their gain is smaller than the sum of their separate gains because each unused memory falls under only one bottleneck. Appendix F.2 provides the component analysis with confidence intervals and details of both methods.
blocks.zh: 损失的较大份额来自达到L2输入但仍未被使用的记忆. 它们占了xMemory未用记忆的78%,而EverMemOS的86%. 这种应用失败有助于解释为什么EverMemOS从L1的第三位跌至L2的第十位,而xMemory从第五位跌至第十三位. 我们引入了约束性援助(ACB),它决定了每个记忆中的事实的主题、范围、地位和适用性,然后将经过验证的条件与生成联系在一起。 表5再次与分解相匹配:ACB在M1(+6.8和+6.6 S'\bar{S})上改进了最多的xMemory和EverMemOS,其中相关事实已经存在,实验隔离它们是否被解释和执行,而LightMem增益较少,因为其主要瓶颈是缺少证据,ACB无法恢复. 合并后,两个模块在两个级别上对每个系统都表现最好,但其收益比各自收益的总和还小,因为每个未使用的内存都只属于一个瓶颈. 附录F.2提供了两种方法的置信间隔和细节。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented GroupAssistBench , a benchmark built from real-world group conversations with a deployed assistant. It evaluates memory recall and use over the same histories when the required memories are single, multiple, or conflicting. Required memories are anchored to source messages, and L2 rubrics translate real user feedback into criteria tailored to each request. Across LLMs given full context, retrieval methods, and memory systems, recall did not reliably translate into use. The strongest memory system surpassed the same backbone given full context on recall but lagged far behind on use, which declined further with multiple and conflicting memories. Relational Evidence Refinement and Assistance Constraint Binding improved all three tested memory systems by addressing complementary failures in retrieving relevant memories and applying those already available. We hope GroupAssistBench shifts memory evaluation from what systems recall to what they enable a group to do.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了GroupAssist Bench,这是根据与部署的助理进行现实世界小组对话而建立的基准。 它评价当所需的记忆是单一的、多重的或相互冲突的时,记忆的回想和在同样的历史中使用。 必需的记忆被固定在源消息上,而L2 robrics将真实的用户反馈转化为适合每个请求的标准. 在全部上下文、检索方法和内存系统方面,回顾没有可靠地转化为使用。 最强的记忆系统超越了同一个主干,因为记忆是全面的,但远远落后于使用,由于多重和相互矛盾的记忆而进一步下降。 通过解决在取回相关记忆方面的互补故障并应用已有的记忆,完善和协助约束,改进了所有三个经过测试的内存系统。 我们希望GroupAssist Bench将记忆评价从系统回想到使一个群体能够做的事情。

This study uses pseudonymized group-chat records.
The use of these records for research was reviewed and approved through the data provider’s privacy review process before the data were made available to the authors.

Any release of derived benchmark artefacts will undergo an additional privacy and compliance review to further reduce disclosure and re-identification risks.

blocks.en: Upon acceptance, we will publicly release all author-owned code and privacy-reviewed derived benchmark artefacts necessary to reproduce the reported results. The benchmark release will include the rewritten and pseudonymized Chinese and English group histories, member profiles, queries, per-instance history cutoffs and split manifests, source-linked anchors and evidence spans, L1 reference and distractor atoms, and L2 rubrics with criterion types and weights. The code release will include the exact task and evaluator prompts, benchmark construction and validation pipeline, evaluator parsing and deterministic scoring code, result aggregation scripts, author-written baseline adapters, configurations, the relational evidence organisation and assistance constraint binding implementations, end-to-end run scripts, dependency specifications, and model and API version information. We will also release the model responses, evaluator judgments, and aggregate run metadata underlying the reported tables so that the reported scores can be verified without rerunning proprietary models. For third-party implementations or model weights that we cannot redistribute, we will provide versioned references together with our patches, adapters, and configurations. All released artefacts will be accompanied by explicit licenses or data-use terms. Original source records and the other restricted materials listed in the Ethics Statement will remain private.
blocks.zh: 一旦被接受,我们将公开发布所有作者拥有的代码和隐私审查衍生的基准手工艺品,以复制报告的结果。 基准发布将包括重写和假名的中英文组历史,成员简介,查询,每集历史截断和分块清单,源链接锚和证据跨度,L1参考和分心原子等,以及具有标准类型和权重的L2卢克. 代码发布将包括精确的任务和评估提示、基准构建和验证管道、评估人员解析和确定评分码、结果汇总脚本、作者撰写的基准适配器、配置、关系证据组织和援助约束约束约束执行、端到端运行脚本、依赖性规格、模型和API版本信息。 我们还将公布模型答复、评价判断和作为报告表格基础的汇总运行元数据,以便在不重新运行专有模型的情况下核实报告的分数。 对于我们无法重新分配的第三方实施或模型权重,我们将与我们的补丁、适配器和配置一起提供版本参考。 所有释放的手工艺品都将附有明确的许可证或数据使用条款。 原始来源记录和《道德操守声明》所列其他受限制材料将保持非公开。

blocks.en: Appendix A Construction Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 建筑细节

blocks.en: This appendix expands the construction pipeline in Section 3.2 and follows the same order as Figure 2 . Unless otherwise stated, the counts refer to the full validated pool over all groups, from which the evaluation set in Table 2 is sampled. All model calls in the pipeline use GPT-5.5, and their cost is reported in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 本附录扩展了第3.2节的施工管道,并遵循了图2的顺序。 除另有说明外,计数是指对所有组别进行充分验证的集合,从中抽取表2中设定的评价. 管道中的所有型号呼叫都使用GPT-5.5,其成本在附录一中报告。

blocks.en: A.1 Data Source and Processing
blocks.zh: A.1 数据来源和处理

blocks.en: From the group conversations available to us we keep those with at least two members, sustained use of the assistant, and a complete message timeline, which yields 50 groups. Every group is used in full; no segment is removed for evaluation purposes.
blocks.zh: 从我们可以利用的小组对话中,我们保留至少有两个成员的成员,持续使用助理,以及一个完整的信息时间表,这个时间表产生50个小组。 每个组全部使用;没有为评价目的去除分会。

blocks.en: All conversations are de-identified before they reach the authors. Member identifiers are replaced with per-group pseudonyms, message texts are rewritten to remove residual personal information while preserving the facts, values, and speaker of each message, and a small fraction of messages (2.5%) are replaced by placeholders of a safety filter. Non-text messages such as images and files are kept as placeholders that name the attachment. Each message keeps its speaker, timestamp, reply relation, and whether it is sent by a member or the assistant. The language of evaluation is described in Appendix H.1 .
blocks.zh: 所有谈话在与提交人接触之前均取消身份。 成员识别符被每个组名的假名所取代,消息文本被重写去去除剩余个人信息,同时保留每个消息的事实,值和扬声器,一小部分消息(2.5%)被安全过滤器的占位符所取代. 图像和文件等非文本信息作为指定附件的占位符保存. 每条电文都保留其扬声器,时间戳,回覆关系,无论是成员还是助理发送. 评价的语言见附录H.1。

blocks.en: A.2 Locating Requests
blocks.zh: A.2 分配请求

blocks.en: A service point is a message that mentions the assistant or immediately precedes an assistant reply. A lightweight classifier discards service points that are not requests, such as small talk or comments on a previous reply. Each remaining request is answered twice by the same model, once with the preceding history and once without it, and a comparator labels the contribution of the history as strong , weak , or none . Requests labelled none are discarded. Information that only appears in earlier assistant replies is excluded when judging the contribution, since it is generated content rather than memory of the group. Of 13,782 service points, 10,191 are requests and 7,926 are retained (6,772 strong and 1,154 weak).
blocks.zh: 服务点是指提及助理或立即在助理回复前发出的信息. 轻量级分类器丢弃不是请求的服务点,例如小说或对上一个回复的评论. 每个剩余的请求都用同一种模式两次回答,一次有前一次历史,一次没有历史,一个参照国将历史的贡献标为强,弱,或无. 没有标注的请求被丢弃。 在判断贡献时,只出现在先前的助理答复中的信息被排除在外,因为它是生成的内容,而不是对小组的记忆。 在13 782个服务点中,10 191个是请求点,7 926个是保留点(6 772个强和1 154个弱)。

blocks.en: A.3 Anchoring Memories
blocks.zh: A.3 沉思回忆

blocks.en: Anchors are proposed in one call with two passes. The first pass extracts candidate facts that the response depends on, and the second pass removes candidates whose absence would not change the response. Each anchor must state its fact without pointer expressions such as “the time mentioned above”, and anchors that contain such expressions are rejected by a word list. The evidence span of each anchor is matched verbatim against the cited message, and anchors that fail are rejected (154 of 22,843 proposals). When a fact appears repeatedly, a rescan of the history anchors it to the earliest message that establishes it, and earlier lexical matches are flagged since a lexical match does not necessarily establish the same fact. Anchors whose source message is an assistant message are marked, and the reviewer in Appendix A.6 checks whether they relay a fact established by a member. Verified anchors are tracked in a per-group inventory that records which instances consume each anchor, which is used to select uncovered anchors for authored instances.
blocks.zh: 锁定器在一次呼叫中提出,并有两个通行证。 第一张通行证取出应答所依赖的候选人事实,而第二张通行证取出那些缺席不会改变应答的候选人. 每个主播必须说明其事实,而不使用诸如“上述时间”等指针表达方式,包含此类表达方式的站点被一个单词列表所拒绝。 每个锚的证据跨度与所引用的信息逐字对应,失败的锚被否决(22 843个提案中的154个提案)。 当一个事实反复出现时,历史的再扫描将它固定在最早建立它的信息上,而更早的词汇匹配被标出,因为一个词汇匹配不一定确定同样的事实. 源信息为助理消息的锁定者被标记,附录A.6中的审查者检查他们是否转发了成员确定的事实. 每个组的盘点中都追踪到经核实的锚,记录每个锚的消耗情况,用于为编写实例选择已发现的锚。

blocks.en: A.4 Assigning Dependency Types
blocks.zh: A.4 指定依赖类型

blocks.en: Anchors from the same message and near-duplicate facts are merged into one memory unit , and anchors that only carry the profile of a member do not count. An instance with one unit is M1, and an instance with two or more units is M2.
blocks.zh: 来自同一消息和近似重复的事实的锁定器被合并成一个内存单位,而只携带一个成员特征的锚不计数. 一个单位的例子是M1,一个两个或两个以上单位的例子是M2。

blocks.en: Candidate conflict pairs are detected from update expressions and from changes of the value in the same slot, and each new value is paired with the anchor that established the earlier value. Disagreements between members are included only if the conversation later resolves them. Each candidate pair receives three independent votes on the relation between the two values, including true update , different slot , range extension , rephrase , and goal versus status . Pairs with three true update votes are accepted, and the other pairs are not used unless a human annotator confirms them. Of 595 candidate pairs, 338 are accepted. For each accepted pair, we check that the new value is still current at the cutoff. If the matter changes again later, the cutoff is moved before the next change, or the pair is dropped. A M3 instance further requires at least two anchors on the same matter from members other than the one who makes the update, so that it keeps the structure of M2. The superseded value is excluded from the grounding criteria and enters the penalty criteria instead (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 从更新表达式和同一个槽中值的变化中检测出候选相冲突配对,每个新相冲突配对的值与确定更早值的锚定相配. 成员之间的分歧只有在后来的对话解决时才包括在内。 每对候选人在两个值之间的关系上, 获得3个真实更新票的对等被接受,其他对等则不使用,除非人类注释者予以确认. 595对候选人中,338对被接受。 对于每个被接受的对子,我们检查新值是否在截取时仍然处于时态. 事发后再有变化的,在下个变化之前会移出截取,或者丢出相对. M3实例进一步要求除更新成员外的成员至少就同一事项提供两个锚地,从而保持了M2的结构. 被取代的价值被排除在基准标准之外,而是列入惩罚标准(附录B)。

blocks.en: A.5 Building Instances
blocks.zh: A.5 建筑实例

blocks.en: Native instances keep the original request of a member and place the cutoff at the request message. For authored instances, the query type is assigned by the pipeline in rotation from a list of nine types: single-fact recall, multi-entity attribute mapping, attribution, state tracking, constraint compliance, update resolution, aggregation, personalized assistance, and arbitration among members. Every factual premise in an authored query must cite a source message and a matching span, which is verified in the same way as an anchor. The cutoff of an authored instance is placed between δ min = \delta_{\min}= 20 and δ max = \delta_{\max}= 200 messages after its last anchor (Section 3.2 ), so that the instances cover a range of distances between a memory and its use, and no update of the same matter may fall within this range. How the cutoff restricts the input of each system at evaluation time is described in Appendix E.1 . For L1 instances, the reference answer is split into atomic facts, one for each anchor, and for M3 instances the superseded value is recorded as a distractor. Rubrics of L2 instances are assembled as described in Section 3.3 and Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 原生实例保留一个成员的原始请求,并在请求消息下放置截取. 对于被作者实例,查询类型由管道从9个类型列表中轮流指定:单事实召回,多实体属性映射,归属,状态跟踪,约束遵守,更新解析,汇总,个性化协助,成员仲裁. 作者查询中的每一个事实前提都必须引用一个源消息和一个匹配的跨度,这与主锚一样得到验证. 作者实例的截断位置在 \ min =\delta_{\min}= 20 和\ max =\delta_{\max}= 200 个消息之间(第3.2节),这样,实例涵盖一个内存与其使用之间的相距范围,同一事项的任何更新都不得属于这个范围. 附录E.1说明了截止时间如何限制每个系统在评价时间的投入。 对于L1实例,参考答案被分解为原子事实,每个锚一个,对于M3实例,被取代的值被记录为分心器. 如第3.3节和附录B所述,L2类Rubrics的组装。

blocks.en: A.6 Quality Control
blocks.zh: A.6 质量控制

blocks.en: An instance is rejected if (i) any anchor or cited premise does not precede the cutoff, (ii) any evidence span is not found verbatim in the cited message, (iii) the query reveals a required memory, names an evaluation dimension, or, for M3 instances, contains words that hint at a change, (iv) the cutoff leaves almost no history, or (v) the rubric violates the constraints in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 如果(一) 任何锚或被引用的前提不在断接之前,(二) 在被引用的信息中未逐字找到任何证据跨度,(三) 查询显示需要的内存,命名一个评价维度,或(就M3实例而言)包含暗示有变化的字句,(四) 断接几乎没有留下历史,或(五) 路由违反附录B的限制.

blocks.en: A reviewer model then checks (i) whether each anchor is necessary, by testing whether a smaller set of anchors is sufficient, (ii) whether the query can be answered from its own wording, (iii) whether an anchor in an assistant message relays a fact established by a member or content generated by the assistant, and (iv) whether the two values of a M3 instance belong to the same matter. For every negative judgment the reviewer must quote the span that supports it, and quotes that are not found in the conversation invalidate the judgment. Instances that fail either layer are excluded from the pool but kept in the audit log with the reason. In total, 9,542 instances pass both layers and 440 are excluded.
blocks.zh: 一个审查员模型然后检查(一)每个主播是否必要,通过测试一个更小的一组主播是否足够,(二)询问是否能够从自己的措辞中解答,(三)一个助理消息中的主播是否转发一个成员确定的事实或助理生成的内容,(四)一个M3实例的两个值是否属于同一事项. 对于每一个负面的判断,评论者必须引用支持它的跨度,并引用谈话中找不到的使判断无效. 任何一层都失败的事例不列入现金池,但保留在审计记录中并说明原因。 共有9 542起两层都通过,440起被排除在外。

When more than four criteria are mandatory, those with the lowest weights are downgraded to optional criteria with weight 1 1 rather than removed.

blocks.en: Table 7 lists the five failure patterns summarised from negative user feedback, together with the condition under which each pattern is instantiated for an instance and the number of feedback items behind it. Every instantiated criterion cites the message that provides its evidence. A penalty criterion is phrased as a description of the failure and is judged as met when the response commits the failure, as instructed in the L2 evaluation prompt (Table H.3 ).
blocks.zh: 表7列出了从用户负面反馈中归纳出来的五个故障模式,以及每个模式作为实例被即时化的条件和背后的反馈项目数量. 每个即时标准都引用了提供证据的信息。 处罚标准是作为对失败的描述,按照L2评估快报(表H.3)的指示,在答复作出失败时被判定为符合要求。

blocks.en: The five patterns come from negative feedback of our seed data, obtained in three steps. 1. Collection. Every member message that immediately follows an assistant reply and expresses a negative reaction (keyword filter): 423 candidates from five groups. 2. Filtering. A language model discards candidates that do not address the assistant, do not correct or object to the reply, or dispute subject knowledge rather than anything about the members: 97 remain (22.9%). 3. Clustering. The 97 corrections are grouped by what the assistant got wrong: a member’s current state (23), a recalled fact (24), an explicit agreement or persona (21), a superseded value (12), an earlier statement or settled plan (17).
blocks.zh: 这五个模式来自对种子数据的负面反馈,分三个步骤获得. 1. 收款。 每条成员信息,只要紧接助理回复并表达负面反应(关键词过滤器):来自五组的423名候选人. 2. 过滤。 一个语言模型抛弃了不与助手交谈,不纠正或反对答复,或对主题知识有争议而不是对成员有任何争议的候选人:97个留有(22.9%). 3. 集群。 97项更正按助理所犯错误分类:成员的现状(23起)、被回顾的事实(24起)、明确协议或人a(21起)、被取代的价值(12起)、先前的声明或已解决的计划(17起)。

blocks.en: Collection. Every member message that immediately follows an assistant reply and expresses a negative reaction (keyword filter): 423 candidates from five groups.
blocks.zh: 藏经. 每条成员信息,只要紧接助理回复并表达负面反应(关键词过滤器):来自五组的423名候选人.

blocks.en: Filtering. A language model discards candidates that do not address the assistant, do not correct or object to the reply, or dispute subject knowledge rather than anything about the members: 97 remain (22.9%).
blocks.zh: 滤取. 一个语言模型抛弃了不与助手交谈,不纠正或反对答复,或对主题知识有争议而不是对成员有任何争议的候选人:97个留有(22.9%).

blocks.en: Clustering. The 97 corrections are grouped by what the assistant got wrong: a member’s current state (23), a recalled fact (24), an explicit agreement or persona (21), a superseded value (12), an earlier statement or settled plan (17).
blocks.zh: 聚会. 97项更正按助理所犯错误分类:成员的现状(23起)、被回顾的事实(24起)、明确协议或人a(21起)、被取代的价值(12起)、先前的声明或已解决的计划(17起)。

blocks.en:
Four in five corrections concern the fidelity of the assistant’s memory of members’ states and facts rather than tone or knowledge, and the weights in Table 7 follow this ranking; the superseded-value weight is raised to − 2 -2 for M3 instances, where that failure is the defining risk. The 97 items are recorded with the member’s wording, e.g., “not three, I did four sheets” (recalled fact) and “it should be geography now, not biology” (superseded value), and are released with the benchmark.
The feedback is used once, to fix the set of patterns and their weights. Individual instances receive penalty criteria through the triggers of Table 7 , which scan the anchors and the memory state of the instance; feedback from the instance’s own group is not consulted.
blocks.zh:
五分之四的更正涉及助理对成员国和事实的记忆的忠实性,而不是语气或知识,表7中的权重也遵循这一排名;被取代的价值权重被提高到-2-2,在M3情况下,失败是决定性的风险。 97项用成员的措辞记录,例如, " 不是三份,我做了四张 " (所谓的事实)和 " 现在应该是地理,而不是生物学 " (超值),并随基准发布。
反馈被一次使用,用来固定一组规律及其分量. 个别案件通过表7的触发器获得处罚标准,该表扫描了案件的锚和内存状态;没有查阅案件本身小组的反馈。

blocks.en: Appendix C Human Validation
blocks.zh: 附录C 人类验证

blocks.en: We validated three things by hand: the instances themselves, the rubrics of the L2 instances, and the criterion-level judgments of the automatic judge. All three studies use the same sample of 120 instances drawn from the evaluation set, stratified by task level, memory dependency, and source (10 per cell), excluding instances that the pipeline had marked as superseded, and the same three annotators: one author and two annotators from the data provider, all fluent in Chinese and familiar with the group-chat setting. Annotators worked independently and did not see the outputs of the gates, the model reviewer, or the judge. An earlier annotation of the same sample by a second author was excluded: a joint review found that it had applied a stricter reading of the guidelines than the guidelines intended (it rejected 24% of the instances, against 5–10% for the three annotators, and agreed with them on only 71–79% of the instances), and the guidelines were clarified before the annotation reported here. We report raw agreement rather than a chance-corrected coefficient: valid judgments dominate every annotator’s marginals, so coefficients such as Cohen’s κ \kappa have almost no room above chance and are uninformative here.
blocks.zh: 我们用手验证了三件事:案例本身、L2案例的名称以及自动法官的标准级判决。 所有这三项研究都使用从评价集中抽取的120个实例的相同样本,按任务级别、内存依赖性和源(每个单元格10个)进行分级,不包括管道被标记为被取代的事例,以及相同的三个注释员:数据提供者的一位作者和两位注释员,他们都精通中文,熟悉分组聊天的设置。 注释员独立工作,没有看到大门、模型审查员或法官的产出。 排除了第二作者早先对同一样本的说明:联合审查发现,它比准则的意图更严格地阅读了准则(它拒绝了其中24%的情况,而三个注释者只同意其中的5-10%的情况),并且在本文中报告的说明之前澄清了准则。 我们报告的是原始协议而不是一个偶然修正的系数:有效的判断支配着每个注释者的边际,因此,科恩的---------等系数几乎没有比机会高的空间,因此这里没有信息。

blocks.en: C.1 Instance validity
blocks.zh: C.1 实例有效性

blocks.en: The annotators judged each instance on four questions: (Q1) whether each anchor is established by the cited message, (Q2) whether each anchor is necessary for a good response, (Q3) whether the reference facts (L1) or the rubric (L2) are valid, and (Q4) for M3 instances, whether the two values concern the same matter and the new value is current at the cutoff. Each judgment is binary; an instance is valid if it passes all applicable questions. Table 8 reports the results.
blocks.zh: 注释者根据四个问题来判断每个实例:(Q1)每个锚是否由被引用的消息所建立,(Q2)每个锚是否是良好响应所必需,(Q3)参考事实(L1)或标题(L2)是否有效,(Q4)对于M3实例,这两个值是否涉及同一事项,而新值在切入时是流出. 每个判决是二进制的;如果一个案例通过所有适用问题,则有效。 表8报告了结果。

blocks.en: Table 8: Human validation on 120 evaluation instances by three annotators. Majority : at least two of three accept; unanimous : all three accept; agreement is the pairwise agreement for the three annotator pairs. Q4 applies to the 40 M3 instances only. An instance is valid when every applicable question passes.
blocks.zh: 表8:3名注释员对120起评价案例进行人类验证。 多数:至少三分之二接受;一致: 所有三个都接受;协议是三个注释者对对的对等协议. 问题4只适用于40起M3事件。 每一适用问题如经通过,即属有效。

blocks.en: By majority vote, 95.8% of the instances are valid (93.3% L1, 98.3% L2; 95.0/92.5/100% for M1/M2/M3), and every question is accepted by at least 97.5% by majority. Agreement is uniform across the three pairs (90–93% on the instance level, 93–98% per question), with no annotator systematically stricter than the others: of the 480 judgments, 464 are unanimous, 15 are rejected by a single annotator, and one is rejected by two. The unanimous rate (84.2%) is lower than the majority rate because an instance must pass up to four independent checks. The five instances rejected by majority fail on an anchor whose stated fact over-interprets a tentative message (Q1, 2 instances) or on an anchor that is not needed for the response together with a reference answer or rubric that goes beyond the request (Q2 and Q3, 3 instances). We did not verify anchor completeness, i.e., whether a required memory is missing, because it requires reading the whole history before the cutoff; completeness relies on the two-pass extraction and the counterfactual check of Appendix A . The annotation cards and all judgments are released with the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 通过多数表决,95.8%的情况是有效的(93.3%的L1,98.3%的L2;95.0/92.5/100%的M1/M2/M3),每个问题至少得到97.5%的多数接受。 三对协议是统一的(在案例一级为90–93%,每个问题为93–98%),没有一位注释员系统比其他的更严格:在480项判决中,464项一致,15项被一个注释员否决,1项被两个注释员否决. 一致调查率(84.2%)低于多数调查率,因为一次调查必须超过四次独立调查。 被多数人拒绝的五起事件发生在一个主播身上,而该主播宣称的事实过多地诠释了一个暂定信息(问题1、2个实例),或者在答复中不需要的一个主播以及一个超出请求的参考答案或标题上(问题2和Q3、3个实例)。 我们没有验证锚地完整性,即是否缺少必要的内存,因为它需要在断接之前读取全部历史;完整性依赖于双通取取和附录A的反事实检查. 注释卡和所有判断随基准发布.

blocks.en: C.2 Rubric quality
blocks.zh: C.2 润滑油质量

blocks.en: The instance-level check asks whether a rubric is valid as a whole. To examine the rubrics more closely, the annotators judged the 60 L2 instances of the sample on three further questions: (R1) whether every required service criterion is a reasonable, checkable requirement for the request rather than a restatement of it or a generic demand; (R2) whether every penalty criterion cites a fact relevant to the request and can be decided from the response; and (R3) whether a response that satisfies the rubric would be a good response in the situation, with no missing requirement, no contradiction, and no clearly misplaced weight. Majority-vote acceptance is 98.3% for R1, 95.0% for R2, and 96.7% for R3; 90.0% of the rubrics pass all three by majority and 86.7% unanimously. Pairwise agreement is 0.93–1.00 per question and 0.90–0.97 on all three. Penalty criteria are the weakest component: the two rubrics rejected unanimously fail on R2 or R3, and M3 rubrics have the lowest pass rate (80.0%, against 90.0% and 100% for M1 and M2), consistent with the fallback rule that derives a penalty from the superseded value when no user feedback is available (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 例级检查 问: 标题整体是否有效 。 为了更仔细地审查标题,注释者根据另外三个问题判断了抽样的60 L2例:(R1) 每项所需服务标准是否都是对请求的合理、可核查的要求,而不是对请求的再陈述或一般要求;(R2) 每个处罚标准是否引用与请求相关的事实,并且可以从答复中决定;以及(R3) 满足标题的答复是否是对情况的良好回应,没有缺少要求,没有矛盾,也没有明显错误的分量. 多数投票接受率为98.3%的R1、95.0%的R2和96.7%的R3;90.0%的多数通过所有三项,86.7%一致通过。 对等协议为每问题0.93-1.00个,所有三个问题0.90-0.97个。 惩罚标准是最弱的组成部分:在R2或R3上被一致拒绝的两个分数失败,M3分数的通过率最低(80.0%,而M1和M2为90.0%和100%),这符合在没有用户反馈的情况下从被取代的值中获得惩罚的倒置规则(附录B)。

blocks.en: C.3 Agreement between the judge and human annotators
blocks.zh: C.3. 法官与人文注释员之间的协议

blocks.en: We then checked the criterion-level judgments of the automatic judge. For each of the 60 L2 instances, the annotators independently marked every criterion as met or not met for three real responses (full-context GPT-5.6-terra, dense retrieval, and EverMemOS), presented in random order under anonymous labels and without access to the judge’s output, giving 384 criteria × \times 3 responses = = 1,152 judgments per annotator. Table 9 compares the judge with the majority vote of the annotators and with the annotators among themselves.
blocks.zh: 然后我们检查了自动法官的标准级判决。 对于60个L2案例,注释者将每个标准分别标出是否满足三种真实答复(全文为GPT-5.6-terra、密集检索和EverMemOS),按匿名标签随机排列,且无法查阅法官的产出,给出384个标准×===每个注释者1 152个判决。 表9比较了法官与注释员的多数票以及他们之间的注释员。

blocks.en: Table 9: Criterion-level agreement between the automatic judge (GPT-5.6-sol) and three human annotators on 60 L2 instances × \times 3 responses. Human–human is the mean pairwise agreement; judge–human compares the judge with the annotators’ majority vote. Precision and recall are for the met label with the majority vote as reference. Miss: the majority marks a criterion met and the judge does not; extra: the reverse. For penalty criteria, met means the response committed the error.
blocks.zh: 表9:自动裁判员(GPT-5.6-sol)与3名人类注释员就60个L2级×\时3级响应达成的标准级协议. 人与人之间是两码事, 精确和召回是作为参考的有多数票的标签。 女士:多数是符合的标准,法官没有;额外:相反。 就处罚标准而言,满足意味着答复犯了错误。

blocks.en: The judge agrees with the human majority on 89.3% of the judgments, the same level as the annotators agree with one another (mean pairwise 0.898, range 0.88–0.93), and it agrees with the strictest annotator (0.915) more often than that annotator agrees with the other two. Its errors are one-directional. On grounding and service criteria the judge only misses: it never credits a grounding criterion the majority rejects, but fails to credit 14.2% of the grounding criteria and about 11% of the service criteria that the majority accepts, typically when the response states the fact in paraphrase rather than in the wording of the rubric. On penalty criteria it only over-penalizes: it never overlooks an error the majority found, but flags 4.7% of the penalty criteria that the majority considers not violated. Both directions lower the scores; neither raises them. At the instance level, recomputing score and pass from the human judgments with the formula of Section 3.3 gives a pass agreement of 88.9% and a score correlation of r = 0.84 r=0.84 ( ρ = 0.84 \rho=0.84 ) with the judge, above the mean between annotators (86.3% and r = 0.81 r=0.81 ); the judge’s mean score is 0.13 below the human majority, and the ranking of the three systems is identical under the judge and under every annotator. Responses that decline to answer (25 of the 60 EverMemOS responses) are not a source of disagreement: on these the judge and the majority agree on 95–100% of the criteria. We therefore read the automatic scores as a conservative estimate that preserves the ordering of systems, and in Section 5 we treat the share of “present but unused” memories as an upper bound that the miss rate of the judge would reduce by roughly one seventh.
blocks.zh: 法官在89.3%的判决上同意人类多数的意见,与注释者相互同意的水平相同(意为对偶0.898,范围为0.88-0.93),他同意最严格的注释者(0.915)多于注释者同意其他两种。 它的错误是单向的。 在依据和服务标准方面,法官只错过了:多数法官拒绝的基数标准从未计入基数标准,但未能计入14.2%的基数标准以及多数法官接受的约11%的服务标准,典型的情况是,答复以解释性措辞而不是以标题措辞表述事实。 就惩罚标准而言,它只是过度处罚:它从未忽略发现的多数人的错误,而是标出多数人认为没有被违反的惩罚标准的4.7%。 两个方向都降低分数;两个方向都不提高分数. 在案例层面,用3.3节的公式来重新计算和通过人类判断的得分,给出了88.9%的通过协议,以及r = 0.84 r = 0.84的得分相关性(ρ = 0.84\rho = 0.84),高于注释者之间的平均值(86.3%和r = 0.81 r = 0.81);法官的平均得分低于人类多数,在法官和每个注释者之下,三种系统的排名相同. 拒绝回答的答复(EverMemOS的60份答复中有25份答复)并非引起分歧的原因:关于这些答复,法官和大多数人同意95%至100%的标准。 因此,我们把自动评分视为保守的估计,保留了系统的顺序,在第5节中,我们将“现在但未使用”记忆的份额视为法官失职率将减少大约七分之一的上限。

blocks.en: Appendix D Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录D 数据集统计

blocks.en: GroupAssistBench comprises 2,395 questions grounded in conversations from 50 groups: 1,374 questions for memory recovery (L1) and 1,021 for memory use (L2). Each question is assigned to one of three memory dependency levels. M1 ( Single ) requires one substantive memory, M2 ( Integrative ) combines complementary memories, and M3 ( Evolving ) resolves updates, conflicts, or differences in applicability. The corpus contains 80,299 message records and 4,924,259 tokens. Table 10 summarizes the question distribution and variation across groups. Group histories range from 2,887 to 972,839 tokens, with ten groups exceeding 100,000 tokens and four exceeding 200,000 tokens.
blocks.zh: GroupAssist Bench由来自50个团体的2,395个问题组成:1,374个问题用于内存恢复(L1)和1,021个内存使用(L2). 每个问题被分配到三个内存依赖级别中的一个. M1 (Single )需要一种实质性的内存,M2(集成)结合了互补记忆,而M3(演化)解决了更新,冲突,或适用性的差异. 诉讼书中包含80,299条电文记录和4,924,259个信使. 表10概括了问题分布情况和各组的差异。 团体历史从2,887个到972,839个道具,有10个道具超过10万个道具,4个道具超过20万个道具.

blocks.en: Table 10: Statistics of GroupAssistBench across 50 groups. The upper block shows question counts by evaluation level and memory dependency. The lower block reports corpus totals and the minimum, mean, and maximum per group.
blocks.zh: 表10:对50个团体的团体援助奔驰统计。 上块按评价级别和内存依赖性显示问题计数. 下个区块报告总数和每个组的最低、平均和最高数额。

blocks.en: History lengths are measured over the complete packaged conversation of each group using o200k_base from tiktoken 0.12.0. Records are serialized as #turn [speaker] content and joined by newlines. The packaged text retains at most 2,000 characters per message. These counts precede the question cutoff and model context budget, and exclude member profiles, evaluation queries, and system prompts. They describe corpus length, not the context tokens supplied to a model for an individual question. Message counts refer to stored records, including distinct records that share a turn index.
blocks.zh: 历史长度是通过使用从tiktoken 0.12.0.的o200k_base对每个组的完整打包对话来测量的. 唱片被连载为#turn [speaker] 内容并被新行所加入. 被包装的文本保留了最多2000个字符每封信. 这些清点在问题截止和模式背景预算之前进行,不包括成员简介、评价查询和系统提示。 它们描述的是实体长度,而不是提供给个人问题模型的上下文符号。 消息计数是指存储的记录,包括共享转折索引的截然不同的记录.

blocks.en: Appendix E Implementation Setup
blocks.zh: 附录E 执行情况 设置

blocks.en: E.1 History Cutoffs
blocks.zh: E.1 历史断层

blocks.en: Every question, whether taken from the conversation or authored for the benchmark, is assigned a history cutoff c i c_{i} to prevent answer leakage from later messages. Only conversation turns with index t < c i t<c_{i} are eligible for context or memory construction. The turn at c i c_{i} and all subsequent turns are excluded from the historical input. The evaluation query is supplied separately. The same temporal restriction applies to both native and authored questions.
blocks.zh: 每一个问题,无论是从谈话中取出还是为基准作者,都被指定一个历史截断 c i c_{i}以防止从后期消息中解答漏出. 只有与索引 t < ci t < c_{i} 的对话才有资格进行上下文或内存构建. C i 的转弯和随后的所有转弯都被排除在历史输入之外。 评价查询另行提供。 同样的时间限制适用于本地问题和作者问题。

blocks.en: E.2 Retrieval and Memory Configuration
blocks.zh: E.2 检索和内存配置

blocks.en: We build on the official implementations where available and adapt their data interfaces and configurations to the group conversations in GroupAssistBench . The adaptations handle conversation records, speaker identifiers, and question cutoffs. Table 11 summarizes how each method accesses the available history.
blocks.zh: 并调整其数据接口和配置, 以适应GroupAssist Bench的团体对话。 改编处理谈话记录,演讲者识别器,以及提问截断. 表11总结了每种方法如何获取现有历史。

blocks.en: Table 11: Overview of history access and memory retrieval in the evaluated systems.
blocks.zh: 表11:被评价系统的历史访问和内存检索概况.

blocks.en: E.3 Generation and Output Validation
blocks.zh: E.3 生成和输出验证

blocks.en: The API compatibility configuration for GPT-5.6-terra and GPT-5.6-sol uses the supported default temperature of 1, either explicitly or by omitting the temperature parameter. This accommodates the model interface rather than imposing a temperature shared by all model families. Generation uses the adapters’ output limits and retry procedures.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6-terra和GPT-5.6-sol的API相容配置要么明确使用支持的默认温度1,要么省略温度参数. 这容纳了模型界面,而不是强制要求所有模型家族共享的温度. 生成使用适配器的输出限制并重试程序.

blocks.en: The evaluator returns structured JSON. Its parser checks that judgments cover all required atoms or rubric criteria. An incomplete judgment is treated as a generation failure rather than filling missing judgments with false values. The final comparison additionally requires a nonempty answer, a matching source cutoff, and a judgment from the designated evaluator. Section H presents the answer generation and evaluation prompts.
blocks.zh: 评价员返回了结构化的JSON。 其分析器检查判断涵盖所有必要的原子或标点标准. 不完整的判断被视为一代人的失败,而不是用虚假的价值来填补缺失的判断. 最后的比较还需要一个非空洞的答案,一个匹配的源截取,以及指定的评估者判断. H节介绍了答案生成和评价提示。

blocks.en: Appendix F Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录F 实验

blocks.en: F.1 Cost and Token Efficiency
blocks.zh: F.1 费用和托肯效率

blocks.en: We separate memory construction from retrieval and answer generation. Each evaluation item contributes one query, and costs are aggregated across the full dataset. In Figure 3 , construction cost is amortised over additional queries, while the mean cost of each query remains fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们把记忆构建与检索和回答生成分开。 每个评价项目都提供一个查询,费用按整个数据集汇总。 在图3中,建筑费用通过额外查询摊还,而每个查询的平均费用保持不变。

blocks.en: Table 12 reports token consumption for construction, retrieval, answer generation, and judging across the runs used in the main comparison. Construction reports LLM tokens and embedding tokens separately, while retrieval reports their combined total. GPT-5.6-sol serves as the judge model. Judge tokens are included for reproducibility but excluded from the deployment curves because judging is not performed during deployment.
blocks.zh: 表12报告建造、检索、生成答案的象征性消费,并按主要比较中使用的跑道进行判断。 建筑报告 LLM 令牌和嵌入令牌分别,而检索则报告它们的合并总数. GPT-5.6-sol作为裁判模式. 法官的证物可以复制,但未列入部署曲线,因为在部署期间没有进行判断。

blocks.en: Table 12: Token consumption by stage. All numeric entries are in millions of tokens (M). Construction reports LLM and embedding tokens separately, while retrieval combines both types.
blocks.zh: 表12:按阶段分列的消费情况。 所有数字条目以百万个符(M)为单位. 构造报告 LLM 和嵌入符单独,而回取结合了两种类型.

blocks.en: For the deployment comparison, total cost after Q Q queries is the construction cost plus the mean cost of retrieval and generation for each query multiplied by Q Q . Table 13 reports the values underlying Figure 3 . GraphRAG combines its retrieval LLM allocation with one query embedding, while MemoryOS, xMemory, and EverMemOS use their recorded query embedding usage.
blocks.zh: 就部署比较而言,QQ查询后的总成本是建筑成本外加每个查询的检索和生成的平均成本乘以QQ. 表13报告了图3所依据的数值。 GraphRAG将其检索LLM分配与一个查询嵌入相结合,而MinuryOS,xMemory,和EverMemOS则使用所记录的查询嵌入用法.

blocks.en: Table 13: Deployment cost statistics relative to Full Context with GPT-5.6-terra. Construction cost is paid once; the cost of each query includes retrieval and answer generation but excludes judging. N ∗ N^{*} is the number of queries required to offset construction cost, and C C is the cumulative cost for all 2,395 queries in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 表13:与GPT-5.6-terra的 " 全面背景 " 有关的部署费用统计。 建筑费用支付一次;每次查询的费用包括检索和答复生成,但不包括判断。 N * NQQ是抵消建筑成本所需的查询次数,C C是数据集中所有2,395个查询的累计费用.

blocks.en: The accounting reveals two distinct efficiency regimes. BM25, dense retrieval, LightMem, and RAPTOR recover their construction costs within the dataset, but their low costs do not yield the strongest task scores. Conversely, several structured memory systems improve L1 recovery while requiring more queries to recover their construction costs. Overall memory efficiency should therefore consider evidence utility and service quality together with construction costs and expenditure during queries, rather than equating shorter context with a better memory system.
blocks.zh: 会计显示两种不同的效率制度。 BM25,密集检索,LightMem,和RAPTOR在数据集内收回了他们的建造成本,但其低成本并不能产生最强的任务分数. 反之,几个结构化的内存系统改进了L1的恢复,同时需要更多的查询来收回其建造成本. 因此,总体内存效率应考虑证据效用和服务质量,以及询问期间的建筑费用和支出,而不是将较短的背景与更好的内存系统等同起来。

blocks.en: F.2 Intervention Analysis
blocks.zh: F.2 干预分析

blocks.en: All retrieval and memory systems generate with GPT-5.6-terra, so the full-context run of the same model is the matched comparison. Among the 497 paired memories, the fraction of memories that are in the model’s input and are then used is 66% for full context with GPT-5.6-terra, 61–62% for BM25, Dense and EverMemOS, 50% for xMemory, 43–46% for A-MEM, MemoryOS and Mem0, and 24% for LightMem. The gap between EverMemOS and full context in Figure 4 is thus partly a generation-model gap (Claude Sonnet 5 and DeepSeek-V4-flash use 72% and 79% of in-input memories); the remaining memory systems fall behind the matched full-context model even when the memory is present.
blocks.zh: 所有检索和内存系统都用GPT-5.6-terra生成,所以同一模型的完整文本运行是匹配的比较. 在497对联的记忆中,模型输入的、然后被使用的记忆部分有66%用于GPT-5.6-terra的完整上下文,61-62%用于BM25、Dense和EverMemOS,50%用于xMemory,43-46%用于A-MEM, MemoryOS和Mem0,24%用于LightMem. 因此EverMemOS和图4中全上下文之间的差距部分是一代模型差距(Claude Sonnet 5和DeepSeek-V4-flash使用输入记忆的72%和79%);即使内存存在,其余的内存系统也落后于匹配的全上下文模型.

blocks.en: L2 requests are either written by group members (native) or authored by the pipeline; authored requests are checked not to reveal the memory, but they ask about the matter the memory bears on, whereas native requests are ordinary messages. The two types have almost the same distribution of lexical overlap with the memory (30%/49%/21% vs. 35%/48%/17% of memories at zero, low and higher overlap), and memories enter the input equally often (69% vs. 67% for memory systems). Yet memories in the input are used less often on native requests: 58% vs. 71% for full context, 38% vs. 61% for retrieval, and 30% vs. 51% for memory systems, and the gap persists within each overlap band (e.g., at zero overlap 56% vs. 65%, 32% vs. 52%, 19% vs. 41%). The cue that drives memory use is therefore not shared wording but whether the request is framed around the matter at all; questions in existing memory benchmarks are, and requests in real group chats are not.
blocks.zh: L2请求要么由团体成员(本地成员)写作,要么由管道作者写作;作者的请求会被检查以不透露内存,但他们会询问内存所涉及的事项,而本土请求则是普通信息. 这两种类型与内存相重叠的词典分布几乎相同(30%/49%/21%与35%/48%/17%的记忆为零,低和更高重叠),记忆同样频繁地输入(69%与67%的内存系统). 然而输入中的记忆在本地请求中使用较少:全上下文为58%对71%,检索为38%对61%,内存系统为30%对51%,每个相重叠的波段(例如,零相重叠为56%对65%,32%对52%,19%对41%)的差距仍然存在. 因此,驱动内存使用的提示不是共享措辞,而是请求是否是围绕该事项设定的;现有内存基准中的问题是,而真正的分组聊天中的请求则不是.

blocks.en: RER operates between retrieval and answer generation. Given a query and its retrieved evidence, it identifies items that concern the same members, events, or decisions, organises them to expose complementarity, chronology, updates, and conflicts, and adds missing supporting items from the eligible candidate pool when necessary. It preserves the original history cutoff and source identifiers.
blocks.zh: RER在检索和答案生成之间运行. 考虑到询问及其收集的证据,它确定涉及同一成员、事件或决定的项目,组织这些项目以揭露互补性、时间顺序、最新情况和冲突,并在必要时从合格候选人库中增加缺失的辅助项目。 它保留了原始历史断面和源识别符.

blocks.en: ACB interprets retrieved memories as constraints on the current assistance response. For each constraint, it records the affected subject, scope, content, status, applicability, source identifiers, and an exact supporting quotation. Code verifies the source and quotation, removes duplicate or inapplicable constraints, and supplies the validated constraint block as a separate input to answer generation. Thus, ACB changes how retrieved evidence governs the response without adding new memories.
blocks.zh: ACB将取回的记忆解释为对当前援助反应的限制. 对于每项约束,它记录受影响的主体、范围、内容、状况、适用性、源识别符以及确切的佐证引文。 代码验证出出处和出处,去除重复或不适用的限制,并作为单独的输入提供被验证的制约块来生成答案. 因此,ACB会改变所取出的证据如何支配反应,而不增加新的记忆.

blocks.en: Table 14 provides the complete numerical results underlying Figure 5 . RER changes the organisation or completeness of retrieved evidence, ACB binds retrieved evidence to constraints on the assistance response, and their combination applies both interventions. L1 changes are measured in Atom Recall points, while L2 changes are measured in rubric score points.
blocks.zh: 表14提供了图5所根据的完整数字结果。 RER改变了所取证据的组织或完整性,ACB将所取证据约束于对援助答复的限制,两者的结合均适用。 L1变化用Atom Recall分来测量,而L2变化用Rubridge分来测量.

blocks.en: Table 14: Performance gains from Relational Evidence Refinement (RER), Assistance Constraint Binding (ACB), and their combination. Values are percentage point gains over the corresponding baseline; brackets show the 95% intervals used in Figure 5 .

blocks.en: Table 15 reports anchor coverage separately because it describes the evidence supplied to the task agent rather than answer quality. The table includes all four experimental conditions for the two hierarchical systems, whose memory units retain links to source turns. LightMem is omitted because its rewritten units combine and redistribute content from multiple turns, preventing unique coverage measurement at the turn level.
blocks.zh: 表15分别报告覆盖情况,因为它描述了向任务代理机构提供的证据,而不是答复质量。 该表包括两个分级系统的全部四个实验条件,其内存单位保留了与源转的链接. LightMem被省略了,因为它的重写单元结合并重新分配了多个转折中的内容,在转折级别上阻碍了独特的覆盖度测量.

blocks.en: The component analysis exposes different system bottlenecks. RER contributes most to flat LightMem through evidence completion, whereas ACB contributes more to hierarchical xMemory and EverMemOS on L2 through response conditioning. Their combination performs best for every system on both levels, although the gains overlap rather than add directly. Figure 5 shows the same pattern with confidence intervals; the two modules thus address the two bottlenecks of Figure 4 rather than the same one.
blocks.zh: 组成部分分析暴露出不同的系统瓶颈. RER通过完成证据对平坦的LightMem的贡献最大,而ACB则通过响应调节对L2上的分级xMemory和EverMemOS的贡献更大. 虽然收益重叠,而不是直接增加,但在两个级别上,它们的组合对每个系统都发挥最好的作用。 图5显示的是相同的模式,具有信心间隔;因此,两个模块处理的是图4的两个瓶颈,而不是同一个瓶颈。

blocks.en: Appendix H Prompting and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录H 提示和评价议定书

blocks.en: This section documents the task and evaluation protocol used for the reported experiments. We evaluate each method end to end using its official implementation where available, together with its method-specific memory construction and retrieval procedures. All retrieval and external memory systems use GPT-5.6-terra as the task agent, and all reported outputs are scored by GPT-5.6-sol with the same task-level criteria and scalar scoring rules. Method-specific context wrappers and response formats are retained where required by the corresponding implementations; these differences are treated as part of each complete system rather than as changes to benchmark questions or scoring.
blocks.zh: 本节记录了用于报告实验的任务和评价协议。 我们评价每一种方法的结尾,在有其正式实施的情况下,用其正式实施,连同其特定方法的内存构建和检索程序。 所有检索和外部内存系统都使用GPT-5.6-terra作为任务代理,所有被报告的输出均由GPT-5.6-sol以相同的任务级别标准和scalar分数规则来打分. 特定方法的上下文包装和响应格式在相应执行需要时保留;这些差异作为每个完整系统的一部分,而不是作为基准问题或评分的修改处理.

blocks.en: H.1 Task and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: H.1 任务和评价议定书

blocks.en: The source group conversations, runtime instructions, and evaluation prompts are in Chinese to preserve the original meaning and conversational context. We also provide a complete English translation of the benchmark for reference and future research. The boxes below give an English schematic specification of the shared task and evaluation requirements; they are not verbatim transcriptions of every adapter’s wrapper. Braced placeholders denote inputs inserted at runtime, and character limits refer to Chinese characters.
blocks.zh: 源头组对话,运行时间指示,评价提示都用中文来保留原意和对话上下文. 我们还提供了参考基准和未来研究的完整英文译本。 下面的方框对共同的任务和评价要求作了英文的图表说明;它们不是每个适配器包装的逐字记录。 braded 占位符表示在运行时插入的输入,字符限制指中文字符.

blocks.en: Across methods, we hold fixed the benchmark query, history cutoff, language, task definition, and scoring criteria. The supplied context differs according to the history or memories made available by each method, while adapter-specific wrappers preserve the corresponding implementation interface. L1 outputs are scored against the same reference atoms and L2 outputs against the same instance-specific rubrics. Auxiliary diagnostics, where present, are excluded from the reported metrics.
blocks.zh: 在各种方法中,我们坚持固定基准查询、历史截断、语言、任务定义和评分标准。 所提供上下文因每种方法提供的历史或记忆而异,而适配器特有的包件则保留了相应的执行界面. L1输出与同个参考原子对分,L2输出与同个实例特定标题对分. 现有的辅助诊断不包括在报告的衡量标准之外。

blocks.zh: 只使用上下文支持的信息 。 保留姓名,数字,日期等事实细节的确切含义.

blocks.zh: 中文答问. 简洁地处理所要求的问题,而不重复这个问题。

blocks.en: H.3 Evaluation Prompts
blocks.zh: H.3 评价提示

blocks.en: Tables H.3 and H.3 summarize the common core of the L1 and L2 evaluation instructions. Reference atoms and rubric criteria are supplied only to the evaluator, not to the task agent. Every reported output is judged by GPT-5.6-sol under the same atom or rubric criteria, and auxiliary diagnostics do not enter the reported scores.
blocks.zh: 表H.3和H.3概述了L1和L2评价说明的共同核心。 参考原子和标题标准只提供给评估者,而不是任务代理人。 每个报告的产出都由GPT-5.6-sol在相同的原子或分数标准下进行判断,辅助诊断不输入报告的分数.

blocks.en: Each atom is either correct or incorrect. Allow paraphrases, but require equivalent numbers, names, dates, and times, such as 42.5 and 42.50, or 22:30 and 10:30 p.m.
blocks.zh: 每个原子要么正确要么不正确. 允许解释,但需要等同的数字,名称,日期和时间,如42.5和42.50,或22:30和10:30.

blocks.en: If the answer is vague about an atom, asks a question instead, or says it does not know, mark that atom false.
blocks.zh: 如果答案对于一个原子是模糊的,而是问一个问题,或者说它不知道,就标记那个原子是虚假的.

blocks.en: Extra content outside the reference does not affect atom judgments. However, if the answer gives a value contradicting a reference atom, mark that atom false.
blocks.zh: 参考以外的额外内容不影响原子判断. 然而,如果答案给出了一个与参考原子相矛盾的值,则标记该原子虚假.

blocks.en: Separately count extra : concrete factual points that the reference did not request at all. Count each independent number, person, date, or factual matter. Do not count introductory wording, repetitions of the question, or explanatory filler. This count does not affect the atom judgments.
blocks.zh: 单独计算额外:提及根本没有要求的具体事实要点。 计算每个独立编号、人、日期或事实事项。 不包括介绍性措辞、重复问题或解释性填写。 此计数不影响原子判断.

blocks.en: For L2, each numbered criterion includes its kind, signed weight, and check text. The penalty marker is rendered as Penalty in the English specification.
blocks.zh: 对于L2,每个被编号的标准包括其类型,签名重量,并检查文本. 惩罚标记在英文规格中为惩罚。

blocks.en: [G] denotes memory grounding. The answer must explicitly state the specific fact referred to by the criterion, such as a number, name, date, chapter, or key point from an original statement. Appropriate behaviour without that specific fact is false.
blocks.zh: [G]表示记忆地基. 答案必须明确说明标准所提及具体的事实,如从原始陈述中得出的数字,名称,日期,章节,或关键点等. 没有这一具体事实的适当行为是错误的。

blocks.en: [q] denotes a quality criterion. Judge according to its wording.
blocks.zh: [q]表示质量标准。 法官按其措辞。

blocks.en: [Penalty] denotes a failure criterion. met=true means the answer actually commits the described error. A negatively phrased criterion such as “must not misremember” or “must not contradict” is a prohibition. For such a criterion, true still means violating the prohibition, not complying with it. When uncertain, return false.
blocks.zh: [处罚]指失败标准. met= true 表示答案实际犯下了所描述的错误. 诸如“不得误记”或“不得相矛盾”之类的消极标准就是禁止。 就这一标准而言,真正的仍然意味着违反禁令,而不是遵守禁令。 当不确定时,返回假。

blocks.en: Appendix I Cost Accounting
blocks.zh: 附录一 成本核算

blocks.en: We account for both computational and human costs throughout benchmark development. Computational costs include repeated data construction and validation, agent-assisted engineering, baseline adaptation and reruns, and final generation and evaluation. Recorded usage is priced according to the corresponding model, while incompletely logged adaptation and rerun costs are conservatively estimated from the main baseline runs. Human labor is grouped into benchmark design and protocol development, dataset construction and annotation, and quality assurance, adjudication, and experimental validation.
blocks.zh: 我们负责整个基准制定过程的计算和人力成本。 计算成本包括重复的数据构建和验证,代理辅助工程,基准改造和再运行,以及最终生成和评价. 记录使用按照相应的模型定价,而记录不全的适应和再运行费用则从主要基准运行中保守地估算出. 人类劳动力分为基准设计和协议开发、数据集构建和注释、质量保证、裁定和实验验证。

blocks.en: Table 19: Computational and human costs for benchmark development and baseline evaluation. We price benchmark construction, iteration, and agent-assisted engineering at GPT-5.5 rates ($5 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens). Baseline construction, generation, and judging use their recorded model prices, including GPT-5.6-sol for evaluation. Human labor costs reflect compensation actually paid to contributors. Paid workdays are converted to person-hours using an eight-hour workday, and person-hours, effective hourly rates, and USD values are rounded for presentation.
blocks.zh: 表19:基准制订和基线评价的计算和人力成本。 我们按GPT-5.5费率的价格基准建设、迭代和代理辅助工程(每百万个输入令牌为5个,每百万个产出令牌为30个)。 基线建造、生成和判断使用其记录的模型价格,包括用于评价的GPT-5.6-Sol。 人力成本反映实际向缴款者支付的补偿。 带薪工作日按8小时工作日转换为人/小时,按人/小时、有效的小时费率和美元值四舍五入列报。

blocks.en: The human-labor subtotal reports compensation actually paid to contributors. It covers benchmark and protocol design; construction and review of seed cases, queries, anchors, ground truths, and rubrics; M3 update and conflict annotation; L1–L2 pair verification; quality review and adjudication; and baseline adaptation, reruns, result verification, and statistical analysis. Converting paid workdays to eight-hour days, benchmark design involved two experts for approximately 15 days each (240 person-hours), dataset construction involved four experts for approximately 15 days each (480 person-hours), and quality assurance and validation involved ten experts for approximately two days each (160 person-hours). Automated model execution is excluded from person-hours; only active construction, review, debugging, monitoring, and validation time is counted.
blocks.zh: 人-实验室小计报告实际向缴款者支付了赔偿。 它涉及基准和协议设计;种子案例的构建和审查、查询、锚地、地面真相和标题;M3更新和冲突说明;L1-L2对核查;质量审查和裁定;以及基线调整、再运行、结果核查和统计分析。 将带薪工作日改为8小时,基准设计涉及两名专家,每人约15天(240人-小时);数据集建设涉及四名专家,每人约15天(480人-小时);质量保证和鉴定涉及10名专家,每人约2天(160人-小时)。 自动模型执行不计入人行时数;只计算主动构造,复核,调试,监测和验证时间.
